title: A mailbox
description: Data regarding a mailbox, only the minimum information for listing purposes

status.description:
The status of a mailbox, the values mean:
  - REGISTERED	Product has been registered, waiting for administrative tasks to be completed (eg: contract sign).
  - ACTIVE	Product has been activated.
  - REVOKED	Product has been revoked, but it is accessible in read-only mode.
  - REVOKED_FULL	Product has been revoked, it is not accessible in read-only mode. Product data are stored up yet.
  - CANCELED	Product has been canceled, it is not possible to use it. Product data are deleted.
